passage:
A teacher assigned an online project, but one student did not submit it. She later learned that his family had one old phone and no stable internet at home.
The teacher changed the project schedule and opened the computer room after school. She also asked the school to lend devices to students who needed them.
The class discussed the digital divide. Having online lessons or digital homework assumes access that not everyone has.
Technology can make learning easier for some and harder for others if schools do not notice unequal conditions.
A fair classroom does not only ask whether a tool is modern. It asks whether every student can actually use it.
